messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: interactive selection of  R function
parts:
Hi,

I am wondering, whether we can make part of R function interactively selectable through shiny.

For example p<-ggplot(x=input$x, y=input$y)+geom_point(color="1", size="1",shape="1")

In my ui, I want to make color, size and shape selectable from in the selectInput(). 
like selectInput("plot","Plot function",c("color"="color","size"="size","shape"="shape"),selected="color")

in my server, I want to have something like 
p<-ggplot(x=input$x, y=input$y)+geom_point(input$plot="1")

I tried but it didn't work. Any suggestion? Thanks a lot.

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: interactive selection of  R function
parts: What you transferred to ggplot is: p<-ggplot(x=input$x, y=input$y)+geom_point("color"="1").

messages.subject: Re: interactive selection of  R function
parts:
Yep, I agree. In this way, "color" cannot be recognized as a argument in ggplot() function as ggplot(x,y, color, size). Selecting argument in a R function may not be a right thing to do.

Thanks.
